summary_text: The school provides an American curriculum through Grade 10, followed by the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Grades 11 and 12. It serves a student population of over 500 students aged 3 to 18 representing over 27 nationalities. Additionally, the campus is centrally located in Bahan Township, Yangon.
